about: labeled test leases for lease red-flag checker. each clause is marked flag (conflicts with the virginia residential landlord and tenant act and should be flagged), ok (should not be flagged), or either (legal but unfavorable, or arguable; reported but not scored). lease titles are for humans and are never sent to the model. not legal advice.

leases.title: Clearly unfair studio lease

clauses.text: Rent is $1,200 per month, due on the 1st of each month.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: Tenant shall pay a security deposit of $4,500 before move-in.
clauses.label: flag

clauses.text: Landlord may enter the premises at any time without notice.
clauses.label: flag

clauses.text: Tenant waives all rights to request repairs and accepts the unit as-is.
clauses.label: flag

clauses.text: Tenant shall pay all of Landlord's attorney fees in any dispute regardless of outcome.
clauses.label: flag

clauses.text: Trash must be placed in the dumpster behind the building.
clauses.label: ok

leases.text:
RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
Premises: Blacksburg, VA 24060

1. Rent is $1,200 per month, due on the 1st of each month.

2. Tenant shall pay a security deposit of $4,500 before move-in.

3. Landlord may enter the premises at any time without notice.

4. Tenant waives all rights to request repairs and accepts the unit as-is.

5. Tenant shall pay all of Landlord's attorney fees in any dispute regardless of outcome.

6. Trash must be placed in the dumpster behind the building.

leases.title: Fair apartment lease (should flag little or nothing)

clauses.text: Monthly rent is $1,000, due on the 1st. Rent is late if not received by the 5th.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: Tenant shall pay a security deposit of $1,000, equal to one month's rent.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: Landlord will return the security deposit, less itemized deductions, within 45 days after the tenant moves out.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: A late fee of $50 applies to rent received after the 5th.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: Landlord will give at least 24 hours' notice before entering, except in emergencies.
clauses.label: either
clauses.why: 24h is reasonable for most entry but VA needs 72h for routine maintenance (55.1-1229) (judgment call, not scored)

clauses.text: Landlord is responsible for repairs to plumbing, heating, electrical systems, and appliances provided by Landlord.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: Either party may end the lease at the end of the term with 60 days' written notice.
clauses.label: ok

leases.text:
RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
Premises: Blacksburg, VA 24060

1. Monthly rent is $1,000, due on the 1st. Rent is late if not received by the 5th.

2. Tenant shall pay a security deposit of $1,000, equal to one month's rent.

3. Landlord will return the security deposit, less itemized deductions, within 45 days after the tenant moves out.

4. A late fee of $50 applies to rent received after the 5th.

5. Landlord will give at least 24 hours' notice before entering, except in emergencies.

6. Landlord is responsible for repairs to plumbing, heating, electrical systems, and appliances provided by Landlord.

7. Either party may end the lease at the end of the term with 60 days' written notice.

leases.title: Early termination and renewal traps

clauses.text: Monthly rent is $950, due on the 1st of each month.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: If Tenant leaves early, Tenant owes all remaining rent for the full lease term, even if the unit is re-rented.
clauses.label: flag

clauses.text: This lease automatically renews for another 12-month term unless Tenant gives written notice at least 120 days before the end date.
clauses.label: either
clauses.why: long, easy-to-miss auto renewal; legal but a trap (judgment call, not scored)

clauses.text: Rent may increase by any amount upon renewal at Landlord's sole discretion without notice.
clauses.label: either
clauses.why: surprise rent increase on renewal; a trap but not clearly illegal (judgment call, not scored)

clauses.text: Tenant may keep one cat with Landlord's written approval.
clauses.label: ok

leases.text:
RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
Premises: Blacksburg, VA 24060

1. Monthly rent is $950, due on the 1st of each month.

2. If Tenant leaves early, Tenant owes all remaining rent for the full lease term, even if the unit is re-rented.

leases.title: Liability and self-help lease

clauses.text: Monthly rent is $1,100, payable through the online portal.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: Landlord shall not be liable for any injury or damage to Tenant or Tenant's property, even if caused by Landlord's negligence.
clauses.label: flag

clauses.text: If rent is more than 3 days late, Landlord may change the locks and remove Tenant's belongings without a court order.

clauses.text: Tenant agrees to waive all rights under the Virginia Residential Landlord and Tenant Act.
clauses.label: flag

clauses.text: Tenant is responsible for damage caused by Tenant or Tenant's guests beyond normal wear and tear.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: Smoking is not allowed inside the unit.
clauses.label: ok

leases.title: Dense legalese, several violations

clauses.text: Lessee shall pay to Lessor monthly rent in the amount of One Thousand Dollars ($1,000.00), due on or before the first (1st) day of each calendar month.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: Lessee shall remit a security deposit in an amount equal to three (3) months' rent prior to occupancy.
clauses.label: flag

clauses.text: Lessor shall have the right to access the Premises at all times and for any purpose at Lessor's sole discretion.
clauses.label: flag

clauses.text: Lessee hereby releases Lessor from any and all claims arising from Lessor's acts or omissions, including Lessor's negligence.
clauses.label: flag

clauses.text: Lessee hereby authorizes any attorney to confess judgment against Lessee for any amounts due under this Lease.
clauses.label: flag

clauses.text: A late charge of twelve percent (12%) of the monthly rent shall be assessed on any payment received after the fifth (5th) day of the month.
clauses.label: flag

clauses.text: Lessee shall maintain renter's insurance with liability coverage of at least $100,000 throughout the term.
clauses.label: ok
clauses.why: requiring the tenant's own renter's insurance is common

leases.text:
RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
Premises: Blacksburg, VA 24060

1. Lessee shall pay to Lessor monthly rent in the amount of One Thousand Dollars ($1,000.00), due on or before the first (1st) day of each calendar month.

2. Lessee shall remit a security deposit in an amount equal to three (3) months' rent prior to occupancy.

3. Lessor shall have the right to access the Premises at all times and for any purpose at Lessor's sole discretion.

4. Lessee hereby releases Lessor from any and all claims arising from Lessor's acts or omissions, including Lessor's negligence.

5. Lessee hereby authorizes any attorney to confess judgment against Lessee for any amounts due under this Lease.

6. A late charge of twelve percent (12%) of the monthly rent shall be assessed on any payment received after the fifth (5th) day of the month.

7. Lessee shall maintain renter's insurance with liability coverage of at least $100,000 throughout the term.

leases.title: Numbers right at the legal limits

clauses.text: Monthly rent is $1,000, due on the 1st.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: Tenant shall pay a security deposit of $2,000.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: A late fee of $100 applies to rent received after the 5th.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: If Tenant has a pet, Tenant shall also pay a refundable pet deposit of $500 in addition to the security deposit.
clauses.label: flag
clauses.why: pet deposits count as security deposits (55.1-1200), so the total is over 2 months' rent (55.1-1226)

clauses.text: Landlord will return the security deposit with an itemized list of deductions within 60 days after move-out.
clauses.label: flag

clauses.text: Tenant will receive written notice of any deductions from the deposit.
clauses.label: ok

leases.text:
RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
Premises: Blacksburg, VA 24060

1. Monthly rent is $1,000, due on the 1st.

2. Tenant shall pay a security deposit of $2,000.

3. A late fee of $100 applies to rent received after the 5th.

4. If Tenant has a pet, Tenant shall also pay a refundable pet deposit of $500 in addition to the security deposit.

leases.title: Fair lease written in legalese

clauses.text: Lessee shall pay rent of One Thousand One Hundred Dollars ($1,100.00) per month in advance on the first (1st) day of each month.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: Lessee shall deposit with Lessor a security deposit equal to one (1) month's rent, which shall be returned, less itemized deductions, within forty-five (45) days after termination of tenancy.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: Lessor shall provide Lessee not less than seventy-two (72) hours' notice prior to entry for routine maintenance not requested by Lessee, except in an emergency.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: Lessor shall maintain the Premises in a fit and habitable condition in accordance with Va. Code § 55.1-1220.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: Lessee shall be liable for damage to the Premises caused by the negligence of Lessee or Lessee's invitees, ordinary wear and tear excepted.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: In any action arising under this Lease, the prevailing party may recover reasonable attorney fees as permitted by law.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: A late charge not to exceed five percent (5%) of the monthly rent may be assessed on rent received after the fifth (5th) day of the month.
clauses.label: ok

leases.text:
RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
Premises: Blacksburg, VA 24060

1. Lessee shall pay rent of One Thousand One Hundred Dollars ($1,100.00) per month in advance on the first (1st) day of each month.

2. Lessee shall deposit with Lessor a security deposit equal to one (1) month's rent, which shall be returned, less itemized deductions, within forty-five (45) days after termination of tenancy.

3. Lessor shall provide Lessee not less than seventy-two (72) hours' notice prior to entry for routine maintenance not requested by Lessee, except in an emergency.

4. Lessor shall maintain the Premises in a fit and habitable condition in accordance with Va. Code § 55.1-1220.

5. Lessee shall be liable for damage to the Premises caused by the negligence of Lessee or Lessee's invitees, ordinary wear and tear excepted.

6. In any action arising under this Lease, the prevailing party may recover reasonable attorney fees as permitted by law.

7. A late charge not to exceed five percent (5%) of the monthly rent may be assessed on rent received after the fifth (5th) day of the month.

leases.title: Typical student lease with judgment calls

clauses.text: Each resident pays $650 per month for a private bedroom in a 4-bedroom unit.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: All residents are jointly and severally liable for the full rent of the unit.
clauses.label: either
clauses.why: common in student housing but risky (judgment call, not scored)

clauses.text: Tenant may not withhold rent for any reason.
clauses.label: either
clauses.why: VA requires a court rent-escrow process rather than withholding, so this is arguable (judgment call, not scored)

clauses.text: Each resident pays a security deposit of $650.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: Landlord may enter the unit to make repairs requested by Tenant without additional notice.
clauses.label: ok

clauses.text: If any resident moves out early, Landlord may keep that resident's entire deposit as a penalty, in addition to collecting rent until the unit is re-rented.
clauses.label: flag
clauses.why: deposit used as a penalty rather than for actual damages or unpaid rent (55.1-1226)

leases.text:
RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
Premises: Blacksburg, VA 24060

1. Each resident pays $650 per month for a private bedroom in a 4-bedroom unit.

2. All residents are jointly and severally liable for the full rent of the unit.

3. Tenant may not withhold rent for any reason.

4. Each resident pays a security deposit of $650.

5. Landlord may enter the unit to make repairs requested by Tenant without additional notice.

6. If any resident moves out early, Landlord may keep that resident's entire deposit as a penalty, in addition to collecting rent until the unit is re-rented.
